activity_summary: At dinner she took the journey as a plot: a fire, a walk, a barn, a back. She asked if the man in it is the wiser. You said he has seen a house he means to buy. She asked with what. You said that is the fourth act. You did not name a price. The loaf is still a full thumb short of the notch. Verbeke said the looms are quiet and nobody has shouted at him since Lammas. You did not ask him to say more than that.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Told the fire, the walk, the barn and the back, and refused a sum.
